units.source_text: 就这样，原总右卫门和小野寺十内也同仇敌忾的骂起那些背叛者。

en.t: In this way, Hara Soemon and Onodera Junai also began denouncing the traitors with shared indignation.

units.source_text: 就连一言不发的间喜兵卫，尽管没用语言表示什么，但也不停的点头以示对大家的赞同。

en.t: Even Hazama Kihei, who said nothing at all, kept nodding to show that he agreed with everyone, though he expressed nothing in words.
